Job for students at Cornell
Dear Student, Please, pay attention to this great job opportunity! Your opinion is worth a paycheck. Get paid from $5 to $95 just to fill out simple online surveys. Or take $50 to $250 for participating in focus groups for 30 to 60 minutes. If you are interested then just reply to my email. Regards, Peter Hill
